task.description: Design Lua integration architecture covering: LuaJIT embedding via C-interop, state isolation per invocation, stdlib restrictions (math/string/table only), bytecode loading prevention, and host API registration. Produce src/design/lua-integration.md
acceptance_criteria: Design document at src/design/lua-integration.md covers all 5 requirements
C-interop strategy documented (Zig to LuaJIT FFI)

result.summary: Complete Lua integration design document produced. Covers LuaJIT static linking via C-interop (§2), per-invocation state isolation with lifecycle management (§3), comprehensive stdlib whitelist and function removal matrix including bytecode prevention (§4), host API with 6 platform.* functions and capability-based access control (§5), execution model and error handling (§6-7), security architecture (§8), and testing strategy with unit/integration/security test cases (§11).
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV for implementation of Lua executor, capability framework, and host API modules. Execution step should cover Phase 1 (MVP): state management, stdlib restrictions, bytecode rejection, and basic read/write variable functions with capability checks.
